top_signals.title: CityPickle Rides Pickleball Boom
top_signals.summary: CityPickle hosts the Major League Pickleball Championship finals at Wollman Rink in Central Park. CityPickle has been expanding rapidly this year, opening a flagship location in Times Square and another in Boca Raton, Florida, while serving more than 190,000 customers through its app. CityPickle Co-CEO Mary Cannon discusses the explosive growth of pickleball on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)
